subject: Emotions
title: The Michelangelo Effect
description: Learn The Michelangelo Effect in one minute.

hook.text: Michelangelo said he didn't carve David—he freed him from the marble. Good partners do the same for each other.

buildup.text: Rusbult named this the 'Michelangelo effect'—partners sculpt each other toward ideal selves through affirming behavior.

discovery.text: When your partner sees and supports your potential, you move closer to your ideal self. Love becomes a growth engine.

twist.text: The opposite exists. Partners who undermine goals or reinforce weakness create a 'Michelangelo's nightmare'—regression.

climax.text: Couples with mutual sculpting report higher satisfaction, more growth, and longer relationships than those without it.

punchline.text: The best partner sees who you're becoming, not just who you are.

quiz.question: What is the Michelangelo effect in relationships?
options: Partners sculpt each other toward ideal selves
